interface.name: bifrost_layer_manager_v1
interface.description: Lets a client describe a surface's content as a tree of layers whose animations the window server evaluates at every display frame. The transaction body is the bifrost-layers codec blob.

request.name: get_context

description.summary: make a layer context for a surface

request.description: The context's root layer becomes the surface's content from the next commit of the context. A surface has at most one context; asking again is a protocol error.

interface.name: bifrost_layer_context_v1
interface.description: Holds one bifrost-layers tree. Backing stores are bound to contents ids with bind_contents and referenced from layers; commit applies one encoded transaction atomically at the next frame.

request.name: bind_contents

description.summary: bind a backing store to a contents id

request.description: Binds a dma-buf wl_buffer as the backing store for contents_id, replacing any earlier binding on the next commit. The server holds the buffer until it is replaced or unbound and then sends wl_buffer.release.

request.name: damage_contents

description.summary: mark part of a backing store as changed

request.description: The rectangle, in buffer pixels, changed since the buffer was last committed; applied on the next commit.

request.name: commit
request.description: Applies an encoded transaction (bifrost-layers codec) together with pending bindings and damage at the next frame. A transaction that does not decode or does not apply is a protocol error.

event.name: presented
event.description: The transaction with this seq (and everything before it) was first shown at this time, with this refresh interval. The SDK's display link uses it to pace drawing.
